hypothesis: R257's P&L is too concentrated in repeated winners. A 20-trading-day fresh-entry gate, which prevents a stock from re-entering the R257 top-30 score pool after it appeared there in the prior 20 trading days, should diversify realized P&L without changing the R257 factor or 10-position limits.
selection_basis: R257 passed all D/I/G gates and all cost-stress tests but failed C2/C3/C4 with top1/top3/top5 net P&L shares of 27.95%/64.08%/94.43%. This is a follow-up, result-driven concentration hypothesis, not independent confirmation. No R258 forward or strategy returns are read in this audit.

gate_factor.formula: 1 if R257 factor is in the top 30 eligible historical nonfinancial HS300 members on date t and the stock was not in the top 30 on any of the prior 20 trading dates in the common benchmark calendar; otherwise 0
gate_factor.pit_rule: top-30 membership and the prior-window maximum use only information available on or before date t

selection_note: These feasibility constraints are fixed before reading any strategy return. If they pass, the fresh-entry factor and candidate/control strategies will be pre-registered before implementation.
